head: codex/5881-remove-csdlc-claims
title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2] Remove claims from the lifecycle
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5881

Removes claim, lease, heartbeat, and recovery authority from the active C-SDLC v2 lifecycle. Canonical issue ownership now derives from bound branch/worktree topology; 190 pre-existing tracked current records were normalized once, claim-specific compatibility code was then deleted, and historical evidence remains immutable. Active repo guidance and the installed adl_pr_cycle skill are synchronized to the claim-free route.

Focused proof: exact schema 3/3; topology migration 9/9; gate2 1/1; gate5 14/14; gate6 6/6; gate_finish 17/17; gate_cleanup 9/9; gate10a 19/19; strict all-target Clippy; installer sync guard; git diff check. Exact-head independent review passed with no P0-P3 findings.
